title: 第十一章面具人第十七章炼气三层
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: 两道风刃斩向的并不是江离，却让江离遍体生寒。
如此不讲道理也就罢了，出手竟还这般狠毒。
两条胳膊一掉，别说以后修行，便是正常生活都难以做到。
活脱脱的就成了一个废人。
洛仙子脸上，此时没有任何不忍的表情，反而带着一抹冷笑。
这笑意，根本没有把他们当人看待。
一瞬之间，江离竟有了脱离小月宗的想法。
这次斩的是郝师兄，谁能保证下次风刃不会斩在自己身上。
他现在有了修仙功法，还有木盒，脱离小月宗顶多是修行速度慢一些。
那也总比丢了双臂或者直接丢掉性命要强。
洛仙子脸上的冷笑之意越来越浓烈，可就当达到极点之时，脸色却猛然一变。
“是谁如此大胆，敢破我术法！”
洛仙子几乎是吼出来了一般。
就当两道风刃即将斩在郝姓杂役弟子的双臂之时，一道气劲一卷，竟让两道风刃偏离了方向，斩在了别处。
洛仙怒目圆睁看向炼丹房外，一名紫色法袍，戴着一面银色面具的人缓步走了进来。
此人，江离没有见过。
莫说是江离，便是宋展也是一脸疑惑之色。
洛仙可是偏独峰上最天才的弟子，极受宠爱。
除了几名长老以及她的师尊之外，没人敢违背她的意思。
这个戴着面具的人却这么做了。
“你是谁？竟敢打扰本姑娘教训这个废物。”
洛仙喝道。
面具人没有理会洛仙的叫嚣，一指郝姓杂役弟子，平静说道：“此人我要带走。”
洛仙冷笑：“装神弄鬼。还想要在本姑娘手下带走这个废物，做梦。”
面具人显然不想和洛仙废话，直接从腰间掏出一个腰牌。
洛仙一下子愣在了当场。
“还不跪下！”
面具人轻喝一声，这才见洛仙不情不愿的跪了下来。
不仅是洛仙，宋展也一同跪了下去。
江离虽然一头雾水，不知发生了什么，但也只能有样学样的跪了下去。
“宋师兄，此人什么来历？”
江离忍不住小声问道。

The two wind blades were not directed towards Jiang Li, but they sent chills all over Jiang Li's body.
It's okay to be so unreasonable, but he was so vicious in his attack.
Once both arms are lost, it will be difficult to live a normal life, let alone practice in the future.
He has become a useless person.
There was no unbearable expression on Fairy Luo's face at this time, but instead there was a sneer.
This smile did not treat them as human beings at all.
In an instant, Jiang Li actually had the idea of ​​​​leaving Xiaoyue Sect.
This time it was Senior Brother Hao who was killed. Who can guarantee that the wind blade will not kill him next time.
He now has the immortality cultivation technique and the wooden box. If he leaves Xiaoyue Sect, his cultivation speed will at best be slower.
That is better than losing both arms or directly losing your life.
The sneer on Fairy Luo's face became more and more intense, but when it reached its peak, her expression suddenly changed.
"Who is so bold and dares to break my magic!"
Fairy Luo almost shouted.
Just when the two wind blades were about to cut into the arms of the handyman disciple named Hao, a force of energy caused the two wind blades to deviate from the direction and strike somewhere else.
Luo Xian looked angrily outside the alchemy room, and a man in purple robes and a silver mask slowly walked in.
Jiang Li had never seen this person before.
Not to mention Jiang Li, even Song Zhan looked puzzled.
Luo Xian is the most talented disciple on Piandu Peak and is extremely popular.
Except for a few elders and her master, no one dared to go against her wishes.
This man in a mask did just that.
"Who are you? How dare you interrupt this girl to teach this loser a lesson."
Luo Xian shouted.
The masked man ignored Luo Xian's shouting, pointed at the handyman disciple named Hao, and said calmly: "I want to take this person away."
Luo Xian sneered: "I'm pretending to be a god. I want to take this trash away under my hands. It's just a dream."
The masked man obviously didn't want to talk nonsense with Luo Xian, so he directly took out a waist card from his waist.
Luo Xian was stunned on the spot.
"Still not kneeling down!"
The masked man gave a soft drink, and then he saw Luo Xian kneeling down reluctantly.
Not only Luo Xian, but Song Zhan also knelt down.
Although Jiang Li was confused and didn't know what happened, he could only kneel down as he did.
"Senior Brother Song, what is the origin of this person?"
Jiang Li couldn't help but asked in a low voice.
